source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.5 with Figs. 16.6-16.7 (PDF 68-71).

blocks.text: Parallel plate capacitor do conductors se banta hai jo aik doosre ke qareeb rakhe hon aur jin ke darmiyan vacuum, hawa ya koi aur insulator ho; is insulator ko dielectric kehte hain. Aam taur par conductors parallel (mutawazi, aamne saamne barabar faasle par) plates hoti hain, is liye isay parallel plate capacitor kehte hain. Jab plates ko V volt ki battery se joren (Fig. 16.6) to plates ke darmiyan V volt ka potential difference ban jata hai. Battery apne positive terminal se juri plate par +Q aur negative terminal se juri plate par −Q charge rakh deti hai. Har plate par charge ki magnitude (miqdar) Q hai. Experiment (tajurba) se pata chalta hai ke:

blocks.alt: Circuit ke oopar wale taar mein parallel plate capacitor, plates +Q (peeli) aur -Q (neeli), d faasle par. Neeche wale taar mein voltage V ki battery (baen taraf +) aur switch S. Oopar ke taar par teer charging current ki direction dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.6: Switch S ke zariye battery V se jura parallel plate capacitor (kitab ki Figure 16.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text_alt: Q ∝ V or Q = CV or C = Q/V   (16.28)

blocks.text: Proportionality constant C capacitor ki capacitance hai. Aage dekhenge ke yeh plates ki geometry (banawat) aur un ke darmiyan medium par depend karti hai. Yeh capacitor ki charge store karne ki ability (salahiyat) ka measure (naap) hai.

blocks.title: Capacitor ki capacitance
blocks.text: Capacitor ki capacitance woh charge hai jo aik plate par dena parta hai taake us plate ka potential doosri plate ke muqable aik volt barh jaye.
Capacitance ki SI unit coulomb per volt hai, jise aam taur par mashhoor English scientist Michael Faraday ke naam par farad (F) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Farad
blocks.text: Capacitor ki capacitance aik farad hai agar parallel plate capacitor ki aik plate ko aik coulomb charge dene se dono plates ke darmiyan aik volt ka potential difference ban jaye.
